description.en: Apps, websites, dashboards, social screenshots, and product interfaces.
description.zh: App、网页、仪表盘、社媒截图与产品界面。

description.en: Infographics, knowledge maps, technical explainers, and structured diagrams.
description.zh: 信息图、知识图谱、技术解释与结构化图解。

description.en: Event posters, covers, type-driven visuals, and strong layout compositions.
description.zh: 活动海报、封面、字体视觉和强排版画面。

description.en: Product shots, detail pages, packaging, selling points, and ads.
description.zh: 商品图、详情页、包装卖点和商业广告。

description.en: Logos, identity systems, brand touchpoints, and campaign visuals.
description.zh: Logo、VI、品牌触点和 Campaign 视觉系统。

description.en: Architecture renders, interiors, city maps, and spatial concepts.
description.zh: 建筑表现、室内空间、城市地图和空间概念。

description.en: Portraits, phone photography, film texture, and commercial photography.
description.zh: 人像、手机纪实、胶片质感和商业摄影。

description.en: Illustration, art styles, material experiments, and decorative images.
description.zh: 插画、艺术风格、材质实验和装饰画面。

description.en: Character design, pose references, cards, and 3D toys.
description.zh: 角色设定、动作参考、卡牌和 3D 玩具。

description.en: Storyboards, narrative scenes, livestream frames, and worldbuilding.
description.zh: 分镜、故事场景、直播画面和世界观叙事。

description.en: Classical scrolls, historical figures, traditional themes, and poetry visuals.
description.zh: 古风长卷、历史人物、传统题材和诗词画面。

description.en: White papers, manuals, encyclopedic plates, and publishing layouts.
description.zh: 白皮书、手册、百科图鉴和出版页设计。

description.en: Creative experiments, special tasks, mixed workflows, and practical cases.
description.zh: 创意实验、特殊任务、混合玩法和实用场景。

description.en: High-fidelity app, web, dashboard, and social interface prompts.
description.zh: 生成 App、网页、仪表盘、社媒截图等高保真界面。

useWhen.en: Use for app screens, dashboards, social screenshots, and live interface mockups.
useWhen.zh: 用于 App 截图、仪表盘、社媒截图和直播界面。

en: Lock platform, aspect ratio, layout hierarchy, and exact visible text.
Specify UI chrome such as status bars, tabs, action rows, or comment layers.
zh: 锁定平台、比例、层级和画面文字。
明确状态栏、Tab、操作区、评论层等 UI 元素。

en: Avoid vague platform names and generic app mockups.
Constrain text readability and platform-specific details.
zh: 避免平台描述过泛。
约束文字可读性和平台特征。

description.en: Modular infographics, scale diagrams, knowledge maps, and data visualization.
description.zh: 模块化信息图、尺度缩放图、知识图谱和数据可视化。

useWhen.en: Use for structured data visualization, scientific scale diagrams, knowledge maps, and educational infographics.
useWhen.zh: 用于结构化数据可视化、科学尺度图、知识图谱和教育信息图。

en: Define module count and chart type upfront.
Keep text short; model is not a typesetter.
zh: 提前定义模块数量和图表类型。
文案要短；模型不是排版工人。

en: Don't let modules overflow the frame.
Avoid generic magnifier icons in scale diagrams.
zh: 不要让模块溢出画面。
尺度图中不要用通用放大镜图标。

description.en: Event posters, typography posters, campaign visuals, and editorial-grade layouts.
description.zh: 活动海报、字体海报、Campaign 视觉和编辑级排版。

useWhen.en: Use for any poster, cover, campaign visual, or typographic composition.
useWhen.zh: 用于任何海报、封面、Campaign 视觉或字体构图。

en: Hardcode title and subtitle text.
Define single poster only to avoid moodboard output.
Make imagery interact with typography, not sit beside it.
zh: 硬编码标题和副标题文字。
声明只出一张海报，避免 moodboard。
图像必须与字体互动，不能只是旁边摆放。

en: Don't generate moodboards or process sheets.
Avoid generic word art and glossy 3D lettering.
Prevent tourist-postcard clichés.
zh: 不要生成展示板或过程稿。
避免通用字效和光泽 3D 字体。
防止旅游明信片陈词滥调。

description.en: Product shots, detail pages, packaging, selling points, and ads.
description.zh: 商品图、详情页、包装卖点和商业广告。

useWhen.en: Use for product hero images, e-commerce detail pages, packaging shots, and commercial ads.
useWhen.zh: 用于商品主图、电商详情页、包装图和商业广告。

en: Stack material keywords and lighting directions.
Limit promotional copy to 1-2 lines.
Use same face for swatch matrices.
zh: 堆叠材质关键词和灯光方向。
促销文案只保留 1-2 句。
试色矩阵锁定同一张脸。

en: No cluttered promotions.
No cheap plastic feel.
Brand tones should be accents, not dominant blocks.
zh: 不要促销贴满全屏。
不要廉价塑料感。
品牌调性只做点缀，不做主色块。

description.en: Logos, identity systems, brand touchpoints, and campaign visuals.
description.zh: Logo、VI、品牌触点和 Campaign 视觉系统。

useWhen.en: Use for logo design, brand identity systems, touchpoint mockups, and brand campaign visuals.
useWhen.zh: 用于 Logo 设计、品牌识别系统、触点样机和品牌 Campaign 视觉。

en: Define brand keywords first, then visual output.
Require pure white background for logos.
Show logo in application contexts.
zh: 先定义品牌关键词再出视觉。
Logo 要求纯白背景方便抠图。
展示 Logo 在应用场景中的效果。

en: Don't draw random creatures as logos.
Write brand rules including what NOT to do.
Avoid gradient-only logos without scalability test.
zh: 不要画一条喷火龙当 Logo。
品牌手册要写禁用规则。
避免只用渐变没有可缩放测试。

description.en: Architecture renders, interiors, city maps, and spatial concepts.
description.zh: 建筑表现、室内空间、城市地图和空间概念。

useWhen.en: Use for architectural visualization, interior renders, city maps, and spatial concepts.
useWhen.zh: 用于建筑表现、室内渲染、城市地图和空间概念。

en: Control perspective with eye-level camera.
Use warm interior + cool exterior contrast.
Specify materials and time of day.
zh: 用平视镜头控制透视。
冷暖对比提升高级感。
指定材质和时段。

en: Perspective distortion is the #1 failure mode.
Don't over-specify furniture.
zh: 透视变形是第一翻车点。
不要过度指定家具细节。

description.en: Portraits, phone photography, film texture, and commercial photography.
description.zh: 人像、手机纪实、胶片质感和商业摄影。

useWhen.en: Use for portraits, street photography, film emulation, and commercial photo shoots.
useWhen.zh: 用于人像、街拍、胶片模拟和商业摄影。

en: Use camera parameters (f/1.4, 50mm) instead of vague terms.
Add imperfections: skin pores, film grain, natural shadows.
Specify raw unedited look for documentary style.
zh: 用镜头参数代替模糊描述。
加入瑕疵：皮肤纹理、胶片颗粒、自然阴影。
纪实风格要求 raw unedited look。

en: AI people are too perfect — add flaws.
Don't say 'realistic' alone; specify textures and lighting.
zh: AI 人像太完美反而假，加瑕疵。
不要只写'真实'，要具体到材质和光线。

description.en: Illustration, art styles, material experiments, and decorative images.
description.zh: 插画、艺术风格、材质实验和装饰画面。

useWhen.en: Use for illustrations, art styles, material experiments, and decorative images.
useWhen.zh: 用于插画、艺术风格、材质实验和装饰画面。

en: Lock brushwork style explicitly.
Extract master traits instead of naming masters directly.
Specify palette and composition.
zh: 显式锁定笔触风格。
提取大师特征而非直接点名。
指定配色和构图。

en: Without brushwork constraint, AI defaults to plastic look.
Naming masters may cause direct composition copying.
zh: 不限制笔触会变成 AI 塑料风。
直接提大师名可能导致构图照搬。

description.en: Character design, pose references, cards, and 3D toys.
description.zh: 角色设定、动作参考、卡牌和 3D 玩具。

useWhen.en: Use for character design, pose sheets, consistency checks, and collectible toy renders.
useWhen.zh: 用于角色设定、动作表、一致性检查和收藏玩具渲染。

en: Break down facial features explicitly.
Specify clothing materials.
Lock grid and numbering for pose sheets.
Preserve identity anchors for toy conversion.
zh: 拆解五官细节。
写清服装材质。
动作表锁网格和编号。
玩具化保留身份锚点。

en: Don't say 'beautiful girl' — decompose features.
Pose sequences get inconsistent; lock character before sequence.
zh: 不要只说'很美'——要拆解五官。
动作序列越长越容易换脸，先锁角色再写序列。

description.en: Storyboards, narrative scenes, livestream frames, and worldbuilding.
description.zh: 分镜、故事场景、直播画面和世界观叙事。

useWhen.en: Use for storyboards, worldbuilding, live scenes, and emotional narrative frames.
useWhen.zh: 用于分镜、世界观、直播场景和情绪叙事画面。

en: Define who, where, when, conflict, emotion, and camera framing.
Use scene details to support narrative, not decoration.
zh: 定义人物、地点、时间、冲突、情绪和机位。
让场景细节服务故事。

en: Avoid generic fantasy backgrounds.
Keep narrative cues visible in the frame.
zh: 避免通用幻想背景。
让故事线索在画面里可见。

description.en: Dynasty clothing, scroll narrative, poetry, and traditional motifs.
description.zh: 朝代服饰、长卷叙事、诗词和传统题材。

useWhen.en: Use for ancient Chinese themes, scrolls, dynasty clothing, poetry visuals, and historical scenes.
useWhen.zh: 用于古风题材、长卷、朝代服饰、诗词视觉和历史场景。

en: Specify dynasty, clothing system, object references, layout format, and cultural mood.
Use scroll, album page, or poster format deliberately.
zh: 指定朝代、服饰制度、器物参考、版式和文化气质。
明确长卷、册页或海报形式。

en: Avoid mixing dynasties when historical accuracy matters.
Constrain random modern props.
zh: 需要历史准确时避免朝代混搭。
约束随机现代物件。

description.en: White papers, manuals, encyclopedic plates, and page systems.
description.zh: 白皮书、手册、百科图鉴和页面系统。

useWhen.en: Use for white papers, manuals, encyclopedic plates, report pages, and publication systems.
useWhen.zh: 用于白皮书、手册、百科图鉴、报告页面和出版系统。

en: Define page size, columns, table of contents, figure system, and typography hierarchy.
Use readable headings, tables, labels, and page rhythm.
zh: 定义页面尺寸、分栏、目录、图表系统和字体层级。
使用可读标题、表格、标签和页面节奏。

en: Avoid tiny dense text.
Keep charts and captions aligned to the page grid.
zh: 避免密集小字。
让图表和说明对齐页面网格。

description.en: R&D boards, exploded views, mixed tasks, and special outputs.
description.zh: 研发板、拆解图、混合任务和特殊输出。

useWhen.en: Use for experimental prompt tasks, R&D boards, exploded diagrams, and unusual visual systems.
useWhen.zh: 用于实验型任务、研发视觉板、拆解图和特殊视觉系统。

en: Define the artifact type, components, labels, material logic, and final presentation format.
Use clear callouts and a controlled technical style.
zh: 定义产物类型、组件、标签、材质逻辑和展示格式。
使用清晰标注和受控技术风格。

en: Avoid unspecified mixed tasks.
Keep labels short and component relationships visible.
zh: 避免任务边界过泛。
标签要短，组件关系要清楚。

description.en: Multi-style signature selection poster, single signature extraction, and practice breakdown diagram.
description.zh: 多风格签名选择海报、单款签名提取和签名练习拆解图。

useWhen.en: Use for signature design, style comparison posters, single signature extraction, and handwriting practice guides.
useWhen.zh: 用于签名设计、风格对比海报、单款签名提取和书写练习指南。

en: Analyze character structure: density, stroke ratio, center of gravity.
Infer temperament from name shape.
Set writing behavior per style: starting stroke, connecting stroke, rhythm, structure deformation, ending stroke.
zh: 分析姓名字形：疏密、横竖比例、重心。
从字形推断气质。
为每个签名设定书写行为。

en: Don't make it look like font showcase.
Avoid template拼贴感.
Keep brush momentum visible.
zh: 不要变成字体展示。
不要模板拼接感。
保留笔势。

title.zh: Apple keynote 自然科普海报

description.en: Premium Apple-style science posters for rare animals, insects, and educational subjects.
description.zh: 高端 Apple 风格自然科普海报，适用于稀有动物、昆虫和教育主题。

useWhen.en: Use for nature science posters, species profiles, educational visuals, and Apple-keynote style presentations.
useWhen.zh: 用于自然科普海报、物种介绍、教育视觉和 Apple keynote 风格演示。

en: Subject must occupy 50-70% of visual area.
Use pure white or light gray gradient background.
Bottom info area: 4 minimal columns with icon + title + short text.
No card frames, no rounded corners, no decorative borders.
zh: 主体必须占画面 50%-70%。
纯白或极浅灰渐变背景。
底部信息区四列极简 icon+标题+短说明。
不用卡片框、圆角、装饰边框。

en: Don't use淡黄色旧纸背景.
Don't use complex infographic grids.
Don't make it look like children's science poster.
zh: 不要用淡黄色旧纸背景。
不要用复杂信息图网格。
不要儿童科普风。

description.en: Four-phase method for placing products into consistent brand worlds across campaigns.
description.zh: 四阶段法：将不同产品放入统一品牌世界中生成广告图。

useWhen.en: Use when generating ads for multiple products under the same brand identity, ensuring visual consistency.
useWhen.zh: 用于同一品牌下多个产品的广告图生成，保持视觉世界一致。

en: PHASE 1 ANCHOR: describe brand identity in 2 lines (palette, material, lighting, mood).
PHASE 2 INJECT: place product into brand world.
PHASE 3 FORMAT: specify output format.
PHASE 4 SIGNATURE: add brand elements (grain, shadow, overlay texture).
zh: 阶段1锚定：2行描述品牌身份。
阶段2注入：把产品放入品牌世界。
阶段3格式化：指定输出格式。
阶段4签名：加入品牌元素。

en: Don't let products override brand tone.
Keep brand elements subtle, not dominant.
zh: 不要让产品覆盖品牌气质。
品牌元素要微妙，不做主视觉。

description.en: Transform brand identity into a comic-style persona infographic showing how the brand speaks, acts, sells, and responds.
description.zh: 将品牌转化为漫画人格信息图，展示品牌的说话方式、行为、销售和应对竞争的方式。

useWhen.en: Use for brand personality visualization, internal brand training, and creative brand communication.
useWhen.zh: 用于品牌人格可视化、内部品牌培训和创意品牌传播。

en: All colors, clothing, posture, tone from Logo and brand keywords.
6-8 comic panels with short titles and dialogue.
Include Voice tone, Energy level, Social behavior, Communication style, DO/DON'T.
zh: 所有颜色、服装、姿态来自 Logo 和品牌关键词。
6-8 个漫画分镜配短标题和气泡。
包含语气、能量等级、社交行为、沟通风格、DO/DON'T。

en: Don't use generic marketing words.
Don't make the brand persona a random character.
zh: 不要用通用营销词。
不要把品牌人格画成随机角色。

title.zh: 街头意外瞬间纪实摄影

description.en: Raw, unedited street photography capturing accidental everyday moments with real textures and natural chaos.
description.zh: 原始未修饰的街头纪实摄影，捕捉日常意外瞬间，保留真实材质和生活痕迹。

useWhen.en: Use for street photography, candid moments, documentary-style shots, and raw unedited aesthetics.
useWhen.zh: 用于街拍、抓拍瞬间、纪实风格照片和 raw 未修质感。

en: Specify real material states: liquid spreading, ice scattered, paper wrinkled, dust particles.
Keep natural chaos and life traces.
Handheld phone angle, slightly tilted composition.
raw unedited photo look, natural colors, real textures.
zh: 指定真实材质状态：液体扩散、冰块散落、纸张褶皱、灰尘颗粒。
保留自然杂乱和生活痕迹。
手持手机视角，略微倾斜构图。
raw unedited 质感，自然色彩，真实纹理。

en: Don't make it look staged or studio-lit.
No illustration, anime, CGI, watermarks, or poster design feel.
zh: 不要看起来像摆拍或棚拍。
不要插画、动漫、CGI、水印或海报设计感。

description.en: Complete corporate brochure visual system with cover, intro, products, applications, cases, and full spread preview.
description.zh: 完整企业画册视觉系统，含封面封底、企业简介、核心产品、应用场景、客户案例和全册预览。

useWhen.en: Use for corporate brochures, company profiles, product catalogs, and business proposal visual systems.
useWhen.zh: 用于企业画册、公司介绍、产品手册和商业提案视觉系统。

en: Avoid Word/PPT feel.
Choose one of: dark tech aesthetic / white minimalist business / high-end industrial / artistic brand brochure.
Include full spread preview for consistency validation.
zh: 避免传统 Word 排版和普通 PPT 感。
选择一种风格方向。
补一张全册预览图验证统一性。

en: Don't just do text layout.
Use simulated text blocks for body, hardcode only headlines.
System preview validates cross-page consistency.
zh: 不要只做文字排版。
正文用模拟文本块，只写死大标题。
全册预览验证跨页统一性。

description.en: Live stream UI screenshots with host, chat, gifts, and product cards.
description.zh: 直播界面截图，包含主播、弹幕、礼物特效和商品卡片。

useWhen.en: Use for live stream interface mockups, e-commerce livestreams, talent streams, and interactive broadcast screens.
useWhen.zh: 用于直播界面模拟、电商直播、才艺直播和互动广播画面。

en: Lock platform type first: e-commerce vs talent stream have different UI layouts.
Specify host position, chat density, gift effects, and product card placement.
Ensure UI elements don't block the host's face.
zh: 先锁定平台类型：带货和才艺直播UI布局差异大。
指定主播位置、弹幕密度、礼物特效和商品卡片位置。
确保UI元素不遮挡主播面部。

en: Don't mix platforms (Douyin vs Bilibili vs Kuaishou).
Don't clutter the screen with too many UI overlays.
Specify live number and interaction elements.
zh: 不要混搭平台特征。
不要屏幕堆砌太多UI叠加层。
要指定在线人数和互动元素。

description.en: Micro-to-macro scale progression diagrams with 6-8 levels and precise 3D renders.
description.zh: 从微观到宏观的尺度递进图，6-8个层级，高精度3D渲染。

useWhen.en: Use for scientific scale comparisons, size progression diagrams, and educational zoom sequences.
useWhen.zh: 用于科学尺度对比、尺寸递进图和教学缩放序列。

en: Use 6-8 circular or hexagonal frames in micro-to-macro progression.
Each frame: scale name, 3-5 word insight, measurement unit or magnification factor.
Connect with thin lines, avoid duplicate levels.
Title format: '[主题]：AT EVERY SCALE' or 'ZOOM: THE WORLD OF [主题]'.
zh: 使用6-8个圆形或六边形框按微观到宏观递进排列。
每框含：尺度名称、3-5词洞察、测量单位或放大倍率。
细线连接，避免重复层级。
标题格式：'[主题]：AT EVERY SCALE' 或 'ZOOM: THE WORLD OF [主题]'。

en: Don't use generic magnifier icon.
Don't draw all scales same size.
Don't stuff long paragraphs into frames.
zh: 不要用通用放大镜图标。
不要把尺度画成同一大小。
不要塞长段正文。
